Error400.description: The request is invalid; the body says why.

Error403.description: The caller may not do this (TokenReview mode: Kubernetes RBAC denied it), or the namespace is not watched.

Error409.description: Conflict: an ambiguous name, an object that already exists, or nothing to promote or roll back to.

Bundle.description: uiBundleResponse is the JSON shape for a Bundle in the UI API.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 creation time for timeline sorting

environments.description: Per-environment statuses. The bundle comparison shows them and the release metrics bar reads HealthCheckedAt; the timeline does not.

images.description: Container images in this Bundle — used by NodeDetail diff preview.

BundleEnvironment.description: uiBundleEnvStatus is the per-environment status summary of a Bundle. The UI reads Name, Phase and HealthCheckedAt; nothing in it reads PRURL.

healthCheckedAt.description: HealthCheckedAt is when the post-merge health check for this environment completed (RFC 3339). The release metrics bar uses it for time-to-production.

BundleIntent.description: BundleIntent declares optional promotion targeting and skip overrides.

skipEnvironments.description: SkipEnvironments lists environment names to exclude from this promotion, subject to the PolicyGate SkipPermission check.

targetEnvironment.description: TargetEnvironment restricts this Bundle to promoting only up to and including this environment. Empty means promote through all environments.

author.description: Author is the committer or triggering actor for this build.

ciRunURL.description: CIRunURL is the URL of the CI run that built this Bundle.

commitSHA.description: CommitSHA is the application source commit that produced this Bundle.

rollbackOf.description: RollbackOf is the name of the Bundle this Bundle rolls back (if any).

timestamp.description: Timestamp is when the bundle was built.

Condition.description: uiCondition is the JSON shape for a Kubernetes condition.

ConfigRef.description: ConfigRef identifies a GitOps repository commit.

commitSHA.description: CommitSHA is the exact commit SHA for this config snapshot.

gitRepo.description: GitRepo is the GitOps repository URL.

CreateBundleRequest.description: bundleCreateRequest is the JSON body accepted by POST /api/v1/bundles.

configRef.description: ConfigRef is the GitOps commit for "config" and "mixed" bundles.

images.description: Images lists the container images in this Bundle.

intent.description: Intent limits or shapes the promotion (targetEnvironment, skipEnvironments).

namespace.description: Namespace is the target namespace. Defaults to the server's default namespace.

pipeline.description: Pipeline is the target Pipeline name.

type.description: Type is the bundle type: "image", "config", or "mixed".

CreateBundleResponse.description: bundleCreateResponse is the JSON response for POST /api/v1/bundles.

name.description: Name is the name of the created Bundle CRD.

namespace.description: Namespace is the namespace of the created Bundle CRD.

EnvironmentNode.description: uiEnvironmentNode is the static topology shape for one environment in a Pipeline. Used by the frontend to render the DAG when no active Bundle is promoting.

approval.description: Approval is "auto" or "pr-review" — shown as a badge on the node.

dependsOn.description: DependsOn is the list of environment names this one depends on. Empty means this environment starts at the root of the DAG.

Event.description: uiEventResponse is the JSON shape for a Kubernetes event in the UI API.

GateOverrideRequest.description: uiGateOverrideRequest is the body of POST /api/v1/ui/gates/{name}/approve.

expiresInMinutes.description: ExpiresInMinutes is how long the override lasts, 1 to 1440. Defaults to 60.

namespace.description: Namespace of the gate, used only with the {name}/approve form; the {namespace}/{name}/approve form takes it from the path.

reason.description: Reason is recorded on the override and in the audit trail. Required.

stage.description: Stage limits the override to one environment. Empty overrides the gate in every environment it applies to.

Graph.description: uiGraphResponse is the DAG response for a Bundle.

GraphEdge.description: uiGraphEdge is a directed dependency edge in the promotion DAG.

GraphNode.description: uiGraphNode is a node in the promotion DAG.

holding.description: Holding is set on a PolicyGate node whose gate holds the bundle back (graph.GateHolds, the rule blockerCount uses); its State is "Block". See graph.GateState for the other gate states.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 step creation time for elapsed timers

ImageRef.description: ImageRef identifies a container image by repository, tag, and/or digest.

MessageResponse.description: uiMessageResponse is the response of an action that creates nothing.

Pipeline.description: uiPipelineResponse is the JSON shape for a Pipeline in the UI API.

blockerCount.description: Operations table columns: derived from active Bundle + steps + gates. BlockerCount is the number of the active bundle's PolicyGates with ready=false in environments it has reached (every upstream Verified) but not started; see blockingGateCount.

environmentStates.description: per-environment state counts for the multi-segment health bar. Derived from the active Bundle's status.environments. Keys are environment names, values are the promotion phase.

environmentTopology.description: static pipeline topology from spec — rendered even when no Bundle is promoting. Each entry is one environment in pipeline order with its dependsOn edges.

failedStepCount.description: FailedStepCount is the number of PromotionSteps with state=Failed for the active bundle.

inventoryAgeDays.description: InventoryAgeDays is the number of days since the latest bundle was created. A high value indicates stale inventory (no recent deploys). A pointer so that 0 ("created today") is sent; nil means no active bundle.

lastMergedAt.description: LastMergedAt is the RFC3339 timestamp of the last env that reached Verified. Empty string when no environment has been verified yet.

PipelineActionRequest.description: uiPipelineActionRequest is the body of POST /api/v1/ui/pause and POST /api/v1/ui/resume.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Pipeline. Defaults to "default".

pipeline.description: Pipeline is the Pipeline to pause or resume.

PolicyGate.description: uiGateResponse is the JSON shape for a PolicyGate.

holding.description: Holding is true when this gate instance holds its bundle back (graph.GateHolds, the rule blockerCount uses). A not-ready gate that is not holding is waiting for the bundle, not blocking it.

pipeline.description: Pipeline, Bundle and Environment come from the kardinal.io/* labels the graph builder sets on gate instances. They are empty on templates.

state.description: State is the state the UI shows: Pass, Block, Superseded, Pending or Waiting (graph.GateState), the same as the gate's node in the bundle graph and the STATE kardinal explain prints.

template.description: Template is true for a PolicyGate template (no kardinal.io/bundle label). Templates are never evaluated for a bundle and always report ready=false, so the UI must not count them as blocking.

PolicyGateOverride.description: uiGateOverride is the JSON shape for a PolicyGateOverride (K-09 audit record).

PromoteRequest.description: uiPromoteRequest is the body of POST /api/v1/ui/promote.

environment.description: Environment is the environment to promote to; its upstreams must have a Verified Bundle.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Pipeline. Defaults to "default".

pipeline.description: Pipeline is the Pipeline to promote in.

PromoteResponse.description: uiPromoteResponse is the 201 response of POST /api/v1/ui/promote.

bundle.description: Bundle is the promotion Bundle created.

source.description: Source is the Verified Bundle whose artifacts it promotes.

PromotionStep.description: uiStepResponse is the JSON shape for a PromotionStep.

bakeElapsedMinutes.description: Bake countdown fields (served; the UI does not show them yet). BakeElapsedMinutes is contiguous healthy minutes so far in the current bake window.

bakeResets.description: BakeResets is the number of times the bake timer was reset due to a health alarm.

bakeTargetMinutes.description: BakeTargetMinutes is the required contiguous healthy duration from Pipeline spec. Zero means no bake is configured for this environment.

conditions.description: Kubernetes conditions — shown in NodeDetail conditions panel.

steps.description: Steps is the per-step progress from status.steps[], in execution order. The UI renders it as the step progress list.

RollbackRequest.description: uiRollbackRequest is the body of POST /api/v1/ui/rollback.

environment.description: Environment is the environment to roll back.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Pipeline. Defaults to "default".

pipeline.description: Pipeline is the Pipeline to roll back.

toBundle.description: ToBundle is the Bundle to go back to. Empty means the most recent Bundle, other than the one deployed now, that was Verified in the environment.

RollbackResponse.description: uiRollbackResponse is the 201 response of POST /api/v1/ui/rollback.

bundle.description: Bundle is the rollback Bundle created.

rollbackOf.description: RollbackOf is the Bundle whose artifacts it restores.

StepStatus.description: uiStepStatus is the JSON shape for one entry of PromotionStep status.steps[].

UICreateBundleRequest.description: uiCreateBundleRequest is the body of POST /api/v1/ui/bundles.

image.description: Image is the image reference: repo:tag, repo@sha256:digest or repo.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Pipeline. Defaults to "default".

pipeline.description: Pipeline is the Pipeline the Bundle promotes through.

UICreateBundleResponse.description: uiCreateBundleResponse is the 201 response of POST /api/v1/ui/bundles.

bundle.description: Bundle is the name of the created Bundle.

message.description: Message describes how to follow it.

ValidateCELRequest.description: uiValidateCELRequest is the body of POST /api/v1/ui/validate-cel.

expression.description: Expression is the PolicyGate CEL expression to compile.

ValidateCELResponse.description: uiValidateCELResponse is the response of POST /api/v1/ui/validate-cel.

error.description: Error is the compile error when Valid is false.

valid.description: Valid is true when the expression compiles in the PolicyGate CEL environment.

WebhookHealth.description: webhookHealthResponse is the body of GET /webhook/scm/health.

eventsProcessed.description: EventsProcessed counts the signed webhook events of any type since startup.

mergedPREvents.description: MergedPREvents counts the merged pull request events among them.

webhookConfigured.description: WebhookConfigured is true when a webhook secret is set; without one every event is refused.

uiToken.description: The static UI token (ui.auth.tokenSecretRef) or, with ui.auth.tokenReview, a Kubernetes token (kubectl create token) whose user Kubernetes RBAC authorizes for each request. With neither mode set, the UI API takes no credentials and answers only loopback peers (kubectl port-forward).

info.description: The UI API (/api/v1/ui/*, on the UI listener), the Bundle API for CI (POST /api/v1/bundles) and the SCM webhook health endpoint (on the webhook listener). Authentication and RBAC: https://pnz1990.github.io/kardinal-promoter/reference/rest-api/
